blocks.title: The game
blocks.text: Each player starts at 64 life with a 64-card deck and draws a hand of 4. Key numbers are powers of 4.

sections.title: Chips
sections.text: Cards cost chips, not cards. Each turn a player draws chips from a shared pool of 16 per color and spends them to play cards.

sections.title: Budget
sections.text: A creature's power plus toughness is at most 8 per chip it costs.

blocks.title: Advantage
blocks.text: Water beats fire, fire beats wind, wind beats earth, and earth beats water. A blend beats what either of its parts beats.
